operator_config.name: deploymentName
operator_config.doc: deploymentName is the name of the feast operator Deployment subject to selector migration.

operator_config.name: platformConfigCMName
operator_config.doc:
platformConfigCMName is the ConfigMap created by the ODH platform operator
containing the platformVersion key. Format: odh-<modulename>-config.

operator_config.name: platformReleaseName
operator_config.doc:
platformReleaseName is the name used in status.releases to track the
platform version the module has reconciled against.

operator_config.name: platformVersionKey
operator_config.doc: platformVersionKey is the data key in the platform config ConfigMap.

operator_config.name: ConfigPathEnvVar
operator_config.doc:
ConfigPathEnvVar is the environment variable that points to the mounted
ConfigMap directory (or a single config file).

operator_config.name: EnvPrefix
operator_config.doc:
EnvPrefix is the prefix for environment variables that override
configuration values (e.g. ODH_MODULE_OPERATOR_PLATFORM_TYPE).

operator_config.name: structuredExtensions
operator_config.doc:
structuredExtensions is the set of file extensions that are parsed as
structured config (YAML, JSON) rather than simple key-value pairs.
